Privacy Policy

How Milaan handles uploaded orders, statement files and payment screenshots.

Draft for review. This page includes [BRACKETED PLACEHOLDERS] that the owner must complete before treating it as final. A qualified lawyer should review it. Do not rely on it as a compliance certification.

What information Milaan processes

When you create an account, Milaan stores your email address, display name and a protected password hash. When you use your own files, Milaan processes the order details, payment statement entries, uploaded screenshots and the decisions you make. These may include names, payment amounts, transaction IDs and account details.

Where records are stored

On the currently hosted version, application records use a server-side PostgreSQL database and uploaded receipts use private object storage. Files are not available as public links by default. Access is tied to the signed-in account and its saved batches. [CONFIRM STORAGE PROVIDER, REGION AND CONTRACTUAL PROCESSORS BEFORE PUBLISHING FINAL POLICY].

AI reading is optional

You may enter receipt details yourself. Only if you explicitly request AI reading and agree to cloud processing does Milaan submit an image to Google's Gemini service for extraction. Google may process it under its applicable terms. AI output may be wrong and must be checked before use.

Retention, expiry and deletion

A saved batch expires after seven days by default. When a batch expires or is deleted, Milaan schedules deletion of related stored receipt objects and derived data. Deletion may not be instantaneous, particularly when background cleanup is delayed. Database backups, object versions and provider retention may persist separately. [CONFIRM BACKUP RETENTION, RESTORE POLICY AND DATA DELETION TIMELINE].

Access and safety

Only authorized accounts should access their own records. We use authenticated file access, encrypted connections and server-side safeguards, but no internet service is completely risk-free. Avoid uploading anything unrelated to your reconciliation.

Your choices and contact
